saw_lines: Mattress buyers research for weeks, compare firmness and trial terms, then rarely switch once they sleep well.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether firmness and trial terms get read.
Your 30 live ads carry no proof number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Lead the next batch with one number, such as your review count, on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to trust. Collect one, such as your review count or orders shipped, and open three new ads with it on the creative.

0 of 15 copy ads carry an offer or discount, so a buyer comparing mattresses has no reason to act today and keeps scrolling. Put one first order offer or a bed bundle deal in line one of three new ads.

Your 15 copy ads open on 10 different stories, and the biggest, the couples duvet, leads only 3. Spread that thin, no story gets enough repetition to learn from. Pick the two best stories and make the next batch from them.

30 ads have run 60+ days, the oldest since April 2026. Without new versions, the same people keep seeing one ad. Build three variations of the oldest winner: keep its claim, change the first line, test each against the original.

ads_1: Fresh hooks beyond the couples duvet story, each with a proof number
